name: Sign in and save a persistent player profile
description: Verifies a signed-in player can update their account profile and see it after a reload.
steps: Sign in with a supported provider
Change the display name to Nova
expected: The signed-in session is restored and Nova remains the account display name.

name: Create a private room and join from a second player
description: Verifies a host can create a room and a second authenticated player can join with its code.
steps: Actor A signs in and creates a private room
Actor B signs in in a second browser context
Actor B enters the code and joins
expected: Both players appear in the same room, the lobby changes to playing, and each player receives a distinct mark.

name: Synchronize and validate multiplayer moves
description: Verifies moves are validated by the server and delivered live to both room members.
steps: Actor A and Actor B join the same room
Actor A makes a legal move
Observe the move on Actor B's board without refreshing
Actor B attempts a move on their turn
expected: Both boards show the same sequence in real time; out-of-turn and occupied-cell moves are rejected, and the completed result is shown to both players.

name: Show shared leaderboard rankings
description: Verifies completed matches update server-side player records visible from the global leaderboard.
steps: Inspect both players' match and win totals
expected: The leaderboard displays shared server-backed totals for both players, including the match result.
